name: Homeowner has no more photos - AI proceeds with estimates
description: AI asks for another photo after receiving a partial kitchen photo. Customer says they don't have another one. AI should acknowledge graciously, proceed with estimates based on what's visible, and continue the normal flow (recommend material, offer sketch/quote).

messages.text: I don't have another photo, that's the only one I took

expected_behaviors.description: Final reply should arrive within 60 seconds (2-message scenario with image)
At least 2 assistant replies expected (one after photo, one after no-more-photos text)
AI should acknowledge graciously that the customer has no more photos
AI should proceed with estimates based on the visible photo
AI should note that estimates are rough and carpenter should verify on site
